boundary_rule: EXTENDED ANTICOAGULATION IN PATIENTS WHO HAVE ALREADY HAD A VTE IS TREATMENT; PRIMARY PROPHYLAXIS IN PATIENTS WHO HAVE NOT IS PREVENTION. The discriminator is whether the patient has already had the event, read from eligibility and description, because primaryPurpose does not carry it and both registrant conventions are used for both.

trials.why: AMPLIFY-EXT, n=2711. Extended treatment of VTE against placebo. ALREADY HAD THE EVENT -> treatment. The packet named this as a treatment anchor and it was outside the object.

APIDULCIS, n=800. Coded PREVENTION, and it randomises extended anticoagulation in patients who have had a VTE -> treatment by the boundary above. A trial the coded field would have sent to the wrong review.
n=370, coded PREVENTION, 'preventing SECONDARY cancer-related VTE' -- secondary means after a first event, so treatment. No posted results.
abelacimab against apixaban in the TREATMENT of VTE, n=1150. Apixaban is the comparator, which is in scope -- a drug compared against apixaban randomises apixaban.
PEERLESS II, n=1200, pulmonary embolism. Treatment of an established event.
n=1600, 'Treatment and Secondary Prevention of Venous Thrombosis' -- both limbs are post-event.
n=13 paediatric multiple-dose study in children WITH venous thromboembolism. In scope by population; a dose-finding design that will not contribute a VTE or bleeding effect estimate.
ADVANCE-2, knee-replacement thromboprophylaxis. Coded TREATMENT, and the DESIGN is primary prevention in patients who have not had a VTE. Belongs to the prophylaxis review, where it is admitted.
primary thromboprophylaxis in lymphoma and acute lymphoblastic leukaemia, n=512. No prior event.
apixaban vs enoxaparin after microsurgical breast reconstruction, n=82. Surgical prophylaxis.
REGN7508 vs apixaban and enoxaparin for THROMBOPROPHYLAXIS, n=2000.
n=5436, thrombosis and bleeding in surgery -- perioperative prophylaxis.
reduced-dose DOAC vs low-molecular-weight heparin for prophylaxis in haematological malignancy, n=100.
apixaban vs rivaroxaban vs no anticoagulant to PREVENT thrombosis, n=564. No prior event.
REGN9933 for PREVENTION of VTE, n=373. Coded TREATMENT and the title says prevention; the design is prophylaxis.
n=12, CHRONIC VENOUS INSUFFICIENCY with endovenous stenting. Population is chronic venous disease, not acute or recent VTE.

ADVANCE-2, n=3221 knee-replacement thromboprophylaxis. Its coded purpose says TREATMENT and its DESIGN says prophylaxis; the design settles it and it is admitted HERE. THE FOURTH LARGE ADVANCE-PROGRAMME TRIAL MISSING FROM THIS REVIEW.
primary thromboprophylaxis in lymphoma and ALL, n=512.
apixaban vs enoxaparin after microsurgical breast reconstruction, n=82. In scope; its registered outcomes are surgical-flap endpoints.
prolonged anticoagulation for PRIMARY prophylaxis, n=72.
n=10078, individualised versus standard thrombosis prophylaxis. THE LARGEST TRIAL IN EITHER REMAINDER, and not yet reported.
DOAC dosing options in anticoagulation prophylaxis for cancer, n=996.
REGN7508 thromboprophylaxis, n=2000.
perioperative thrombosis and bleeding, n=5436.
reduced-dose DOAC vs LMWH prophylaxis in haematological malignancy, n=100.
apixaban vs rivaroxaban vs no anticoagulant to prevent thrombosis, n=564.
REGN9933 for prevention of VTE, n=373.
single-dose paediatric pharmacokinetic study, n=49. In scope by population; a PK design contributes no clinical effect estimate.
'preventing SECONDARY cancer-related VTE' -- after a first event, so treatment by the boundary above. Belongs to the treatment review, where it is admitted.
APIDULCIS: extended anticoagulation after a VTE. Coded PREVENTION and it is treatment.
'Treatment and Secondary Prevention' -- both post-event.
